title: MapX architecture report
description: What `mapx check --format json` prints: the findings of the architecture rules (.mapx/architecture.jsonc) on the index, with counts, layer sizes and the layer-to-layer matrix.

counts.description: Findings per kind, before --report-* options hide any.

uncovered.description: Uncovered dependencies (targets in no layer) whose source is in this layer.

warnings.description: Of the violations, those reported at warn (an advisory allowance, or an inferred edge under policy.inferred: warn).

selection.description: What mapx check evaluated and kept: the view and the --layer/--rule filters (null when not given). --compare refuses a base report with another view, or narrowed by a filter the head does not share.

policy.description: The resolved policy.uncovered of the configuration (M5-24-R4): whether dependencies on packages and on built-ins in no layer are reported as uncovered, and why for packages. Absent when the configuration cannot be loaded.

externals.description: Packages: value, and source: explicit (policy.uncovered.externals set in file), package-selector (a non-overlay layer with a positive package selector, named in layer, opts in) or default (neither: packages are out of scope).

element.description: A symbol's qualified name, a file's path, a Go package's import path, or an external's name (a package, or a built-in such as node:fs).

file.description: Workspace-relative file (a directory for a package); empty for an external target.

layers.description: The same layers as a list (a layer name may contain a comma).

line.description: First line of the dependency in the source file.

external.description: An external target (M5-24): what the scan attributed the reference outside the workspace to.

rule.description: disallowed-layer, internal-element, private-layer, uncovered, multi-layer, empty-layer, unsupported-selector, plus-cycle, config, stale-baseline …

edges.description: Stored edges this finding stands for.

fingerprint.description: Stable identity: rule, both elements and the edge type, never a line number.

identity.description: The fingerprint's inputs where they differ from the shown elements: a file-level end is its file path; an end outside the root repo names its repo (workspace-relative path).

via.description: An inherited dependency (policy.inheritDependencies): the inheritance path from the source type to the ancestor whose dependency it is, both included; past eight names, the first five and the last two around one "… N more …" entry.

skippedBy.description: Why a skipped finding is skipped: a baseline entry, or the base report of --compare.

location.description: Where to fix a finding that is not about code: a stale baseline entry is in the baseline file (workspace-relative, with /) at a JSON pointer.
